- **`bob help` advertises only commands the dispatcher accepts.** The help listed `office join <name>` while the CLI rejected it as an unknown command, so the command was removed from the help. A test now parses the `Commands:` section, runs the command word of each advertised entry (e.g. `run`, not each of its forms), and fails if the dispatcher refuses one as unknown. (`test/help-matches-dispatch.test.ts`)
